title: betula chinensis var. linearisquama
intro: Betula chinensis var. linearisquama, commonly known as Chinese paper birch, is a deciduous tree species native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Betula chinensis var. linearisquama include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing fever, relieving headaches, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although I couldn't find specific information on all the bioactive constituents.
